units.source_text: 说真的，我这时才了解到河童国也不是一个单独的国家。

en.t: To tell the truth, it was only then that I learned that the kappa country was not a single independent nation either.

units.source_text: 根据嘎尔所说，河童把水獭当成假想敌。

en.t: According to Gael, the kappa regarded the otters as their imaginary enemy.

units.source_text: 而且水獭的军事装备并比河童差。

en.t: Moreover, the otters' military equipment was by no means inferior to that of the kappa.

units.source_text: 我对河童和水獭之间的战争颇有好奇心。

en.t: I became quite curious about the war between the kappa and the otters.

units.source_text: （因为河童的劲敌是水獭是个全新发现，

en.t: Because it was a completely new discovery that the kappa's great rivals were otters,

units.source_text: 不仅《河童考略》里没提过，

en.t: not only was it never mentioned in Kappa Koryaku,

units.source_text: 就连《山岛民谭集》的作者柳田国男也不知道呢。）

en.t: even Kunio Yanagita, the author of Yamashima Mintanshu, did not know it.)
